name: Yaba-Hita-Hikosan Quasi-National Park
nameJa: 耶馬日田英彦山国定公園
aliases: 耶馬日田英彦山国定公園
description: Quasi-national park of the Yabakei gorge's rock formations, the Hita onsen valley and Mt. Hikosan shrine mountain on the Fukuoka-Oita border.
notes: Managed by Fukuoka/Oita/Kumamoto. The Yabakei rock pillars and the Hikosan approach are the draws.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
